name: Acadia National Park
policyReason: Leashed dogs can hike 100 miles of trails and 45 miles of carriage roads.
summary: Leashed dogs can hike 100 miles of trails and 45 miles of carriage roads.

excerpts.quote: There are 100 miles (161 km) of hiking trails and 45 miles (72 km) of carriage roads in the park where pets are permitted.

dogRules.text: Blackwoods, Seawall and Schoodic Woods campgrounds allow pets.
On Isle au Haut, pets are allowed for day hiking only.
Sand Beach (June 15 to Sept 8) and Echo Lake (May 15 to Sept 15) are closed to pets.
No swimming in lakes; most are public water supplies.
Never leave a pet unattended, at campsites or in cars.
Dogs can become Acadia Bark Rangers.
